$comment: Everything tabs needs in Havoc: the app for sign in with havoc. The project (jam) is a proposal - change id/name before the first setup. From any machine with hc (not the NUC; e.g. the dev pc with Havoc/cmd/hc.cmd): hc login https://havoc.geyser.at, then hc setup havoc.app.json --url https://jam.geyser.at/tabs --print-env, and copy the printed lines into the .env on the NUC. SESSION_SECRET and TABS_CONTROL_KEY may stay empty there - the server makes them itself.
